[MATH: ‖Q(x)‖|= ‖x‖; = sqrt(x_{1}^{2} + x_{2}^{2} + x_{3}^{2}); = sqrt((− 1)^{2} + (− 2)^{2} + 2^{2}); = 3.]

[MATH: Q(x) ⋅ Q(y)|= x ⋅ y; = (− 1) ⋅ 3 + (− 2) ⋅ 0 + 2 ⋅ 5; = 7.]
